_note: GMDA's own NGT-facing water-body register. The five in_* flags are GMDA'S OWN cross-survey attribution, not our spatial join, which is what makes a presence comparison defensible. Read them carefully: this layer is the 2012-known population, so a body that existed in the 1956 revenue record and had vanished by 2012 is NOT a row here - it is in the separate WB 1956 (ROR) layer. in_ror_1956=0 therefore means 'not matched to a revenue-record plot', never 'did not exist in 1956'.
